name: Thomas2Go @ BambooHR (Lindon, UT) Gentle Shredded Chicken & White Rice Porridge (Congee)
whyItWorks: Traditional long-simmered white rice porridge cooked in clear chicken broth until grains dissolve into a soothing, silky cream. Requires zero digestive effort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ladle a bowl of warm chicken congee; season with a drop of tamari soy sauce (skip scallions, chili oil, and fried garlic).
watchOuts: None; premier flare-safe corporate comfort meal
